business_scope.primary_industry_name: Generative Artificial Intelligence and LLM Inference APIs

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: China–Egypt Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 1994, in force on reciprocal protection of investments)
China–Egypt Double Taxation Agreement (avoids double taxation of royalties, technical fees, and business profits of AI/LLM API service providers)
United States–Egypt Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force since 1992, relevant to USD payment rails through US acquirers)
EU–Egypt Association Agreement (in force 2004, preferential trade and establishment framework)
COMESA, GAFTA, and AfCFTA preferential trade frameworks applicable to Egypt as a contracting state

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism, as amended by Laws No. 36 of 2014, No. 27 of 2015, and No. 154 of 2019; Executive Regulations issued under Prime Ministerial Decree No. 950 of 2003, as amended; Ministerial and GAFI/FRA–issued UBO disclosure rules requiring every legal person to maintain and file a beneficial-ownership register; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation or Commercial Register Extract of each non-Egyptian corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registrar or commercial registry authority in the shareholder's jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, followed by certified Arabic translation (consular legalization only if the jurisdiction of origin is not party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Board Resolution or Power of Attorney appointing the Egyptian signatory and approving the Egyptian LLC incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or corporate authority in the jurisdiction of origin of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, for non-Hague jurisdictions, Egyptian consular legalization, followed by certified Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and proof of residential address of all individual UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the UBO's jurisdiction of residence or the Egyptian Notary Public (Maktab El-Shahr) if executed in Egypt
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille/consular legalization for documents executed abroad; local Egyptian notarization for documents executed in Egypt

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank verification letter or source-of-funds certificate for the founders' contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing financial institution of the shareholder or UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization where required by the issuing bank's jurisdiction, followed by certified Arabic translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against: (i) the Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit (EFIU) watchlists and the Central Bank of Egypt terrorist-designation list under Law No. 80 of 2002; (ii) the United Nations Security Council consolidated list and UNSC Resolution 1373 designations; (iii) the United States OFAC SDN, CAPTA, and sectoral sanctions lists given USD settlement via Stripe; (iv) the European Union consolidated sanctions list; and (v) domestic Egyptian sanctions and high-risk-country directives. PEP status requires enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, and strengthened ongoing monitoring. Any cryptocurrency/USDC receipt path must additionally be assessed against FATF Recommendation 15 (VASP travel-rule) requirements and reconciled with Egyptian FIU/CBE policies on unlicensed virtual-asset services.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Foreign Trade (GAFI) E-Services Portal – Companies Incorporation and Commercial Registry (Al-Sijill Al-Tijari) module
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 and Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976, every Egyptian LLC must adopt an Arabic trade name. The Arabic name is the controlling legal name and must appear on the commercial registration certificate. A Latin-script transliteration may be registered for foreign banking and invoice usage but must be a strict phonetic rendering of the Arabic name. Names may neither duplicate nor be deceptively similar to an existing registered name, and must be consistent with the company's stated objects and lawful commercial activity.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank / بنك (requires a Central Bank of Egypt license)
Insurance / تأمين (requires a Financial Regulatory Authority license)
National / الوطنية (requires ministerial waiver where state affiliation is implied)
Central / المركزية (restricted; implies central state or monetary authority)
Arab Republic of Egypt / جمهورية مصر العربية
Virtual Currency / عملة رقمية or عملات افتراضية (sensitive under CBE and EFIU virtual-asset policy)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If GAFI rejects a proposed name, the applicant may file a written administrative objection before the GAFI Commercial Registry Dispute Committee within 60 days from notification of the rejection, attaching supporting evidence such as prior registrations, trademark certificates, or distinctiveness arguments. If the administrative objection is denied, the applicant may file an annulment suit before the Egyptian State Council (Administrative Court) within 60 days from notification of the denial. A rejected name may be resubmitted with an altered distinguishing token or a modified transliteration. A name certificate is valid for 30 days; the applicant may apply for a single extension by paying the re-search tariff before expiry, and incorporation must be completed before the name lapses.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office or mail-forwarding-only address does not satisfy GAFI's actual-seat requirement. A serviced-office or coworking arrangement is acceptable for this low-risk AI/LLM API activity only if supported by a genuine notarized lease at the service provider's physical premises and by an Arabic-language lease abstract filed with the Commercial Registry. The registered address must appear in the memorandum of association and commercial register.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for a standard low-risk technology LLC, quantified at approximately 1–3% annualized probability of an unannounced on-site inspection during the first operating year. The likelihood rises to 10–25% if nominee shareholders, cryptocurrency payment rails, or sanctions-related red flags are identified, given the inspection powers of GAFI, the Commercial Registry, and the Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: General Authority for Investment and Foreign Trade (GAFI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per GAFI fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory incorporation tariff under Law No. 159 of 1981

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registry certificate and Official Gazette (Waqa'i Misr) publication of the incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial Registry and the Official Gazette

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Egyptian Notary Public notarization of the incorporation deed, name certificate, and registered office lease abstract
Apostille or consular legalization of foreign shareholder documents and powers of attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and/or foreign competent apostille authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing per-document consular and apostille tariffs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Arabic translation of all non-Arabic due diligence and incorporation documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Accredited legal translator registered with Egyptian authorities

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO/AML/KYC due diligence file, PEP and OFAC/UN/EFIU sanctions screening, and legal advisory on corporate structure
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fixed fee for a low-risk standard LLC engagement

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarized registered office lease for the initial three-month period
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Negotiated market rent and statutory notarization fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Power of attorney legalization for non-resident shareholder(s) at Egyptian consulate in jurisdiction of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian consular post in the shareholder's jurisdiction of origin

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended (Articles 6-16 on Limited Liability Companies), read with its Executive Regulations issued by Ministerial Decree No. 96 of 1982, as amended; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (one-stop shop pathway administered by GAFI).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) — Companies Registration Department and One-Stop Shop; entry thereafter in the Commercial Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association (Etaa / عقد الشركة ونظامها الأساسي) filed through the GAFI One-Stop Shop and entered into the Commercial Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum stated capital under Law 159/1981; however, the capital must be fully subscribed, with at least 25% of the nominal value of cash quotas paid up and deposited in an escrow capital deposit account at an Egyptian bank before filing. The bank-issued Capital Deposit Certificate is mandatory for the GAFI filing; funds are released only after Commercial Registry entry.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] LLC — ADOPTED ON [DATE] BY THE FOUNDING QUOTAHOLDERS. RESOLVED, that the subscription list is ratified; all quotas are fully subscribed and the bank capital deposit certificate issued by [BANK NAME] evidences the twenty-five per cent paid-up capital required by law. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the company is adopted as [ADDRESS, DISTRICT, GOVERNORATE, EGYPT]. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [NAME] is appointed Sole Manager with exclusive legal representation, [NAME] as Deputy Manager, and [NAME] as Compliance Officer responsible for AML/KYC under Law No. 80/2002. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Sole Manager is authorized to execute the incorporation filings before GAFI, the Commercial Registry, the ETA, and Egyptian banks.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Preliminary GAFI Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (online portal at www.gafi.gov.eg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit at least three proposed Arabic/English company names through the GAFI online name reservation module; pay the nomination fees electronically; obtain the Name Reservation Certificate valid for sixty days.
required_dossiers: Copy of founders' national ID cards or passports and residence permits
Power of attorney where a founder is represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for conflict or public-order sensitivity, file a written objection with the GAFI Commercial Registration Department and simultaneously re-submit up to two alternative names within five working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarizing the Incorporation Contract (Articles of Association)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Authority (Real Estate and Commercial Notary Office / شهر العقاري)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the incorporation contract using the GAFI standard-form template: company name, corporate purpose (ISIC 6201 software, AI, and LLM API services), registered office, quota division, and powers of the Sole Manager. Execute the contract before an Egyptian notary public and complete the publication formalities for the incorporation extracts.
required_dossiers: Economic and ultimate beneficial ownership declaration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary issues technical comments or requires supplementary clauses, amend the contract by a supplementary notarized deed and resubmit the corrected version for notarial certification within five working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian commercial bank (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Commercial International Bank)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary capital subscription account in the company's name at the chosen bank; deposit in cash at least 25% of the aggregate nominal value of the quotas; instruct the bank to issue a formal Capital Deposit Certificate (شهادة الإيداع النقدي) indicating the account number, depositor, and balance for submission to GAFI.
required_dossiers: Bank AML/KYC forms with source-of-funds declaration and beneficial ownership attestation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank declines the deposit pending enhanced KYC, provide supplemental source-of-funds evidence (bank statements, executed contract for the project, or notarial wealth declaration) and complete the file within ten working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI One-Stop Shop Incorporation Filing and Commercial Registry Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop — Companies Registration and Commercial Registry Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized incorporation contract, Capital Deposit Certificate, corporate governance proceedings, and authorizations with the GAFI One-Stop Shop. GAFI verifies compliance, produces the Company Identification Letter, and automatically enters the company in the Commercial Registry. The registry extract is then the certificate of legal existence; thereafter, publish the incorporation summary in the Official Gazette and complete the file with GAFI.
required_dossiers: Identity statements of quotaholders, Sole Manager, and Deputy Manager
Power of attorney in favor of the filing agent
GAFI statutory forms and economic analysis forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI raises a corrective query, cure the deficiency within the statutory thirty-day window by filing legalized Arabic translations, rectifying signatures, or amending the contract; if the period lapses, re-file as a fresh application accompanied by a letter explaining the prior rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Social Insurance, and Municipality Operating License Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA); National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI); Governorate / district commercial licensing unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the tax card application and VAT registration to the ETA within thirty days of Commercial Registry entry; enroll the company and its employees with NOSI; thereafter file for the municipality operating license with the district licensing unit, producing civil defence and structural certificates for the office premises. Upon issuance, activate the tax file and commence lawful operation.
required_dossiers: Tax card application (Form 1) and Articles of Association
Copy of the incorporation notarized contract
Governorate licensing unit premises conformity certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ETA opens the file on an inactive basis, apply for reactivation after the municipality license is granted; if the municipality rejects the premises for zoning reasons, file a technical building-use report with the governorate engineering administration to correct the classification of the office as an administrative software establishment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board is engaged because ISIC 6201 is a service activity; sectoral oversight is exercised by the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT) and the Information Technology Industry Development Agency (ITIDA) rather than the Ministry of Industry.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Commercial Operating License for Administrative and Information Technology Services (رخصة مزاولة النشاط التجاري/الإداري) issued by the district commercial licensing unit under Law No. 453 of 1954, supplemented by the e-signature and data-service clearances of ITIDA where the platform processes third-party data.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) — operating under Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category D (Exempt) — pure office and software service activities require no full EIA report; only a self-declared statement of exempt-office activity is filed with the licensing authority.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC process emissions arise from an API platform; office sewage must connect to the public sanitary sewer per Law No. 93 of 1962 and Law No. 48 of 1982. If any on-premises server racks or diesel standby generators are deployed, the EEAA limits for air emissions under Law No. 4/1994 (Article 42) and waste handling under Law No. 202 of 2020 (including spent battery and e-waste segregation) will apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certificate from the Civil Defence Authority (Ministry of Interior) covering alarms, sprinklers, escape routes, and extinguishers; structural load and occupancy certification from the governorate engineering administration; and workplace clearance from the Ministry of Manpower Occupational Health Department for workstations, electrical loads, and employee welfare areas — all conditions precedent to the final municipality operating license.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance — official portal https://www.eta.gov.eg; electronic invoicing platform https://platform.einvoice.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: After incorporation of the LLC in the Commercial Registry, the ETA issues a Tax Identification Number (TIN) manifesting as a tax card. The foreign applicant must file notarized constitutional documents, board resolution, power of attorney, and proof of address, and appoint a resident tax representative. Separate registration for VAT is compulsory once the annual taxable turnover exceeds EGP 500,000, or earlier for the specific transactions or voluntary registration. Payroll, contract, and stamp tax registrations are obtained simultaneously through the ETA one-stop registration window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists in Egypt. An LLC is mandatorily treated as a separate taxable juridical person under Law No. 91 of 2005 and Law No. 67 of 2016. Pass-through treatment is unavailable to LLC members. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available; the Egyptian Domestic and DTT framework follows the BEPS hybrid mismatch rules on a statutory, non-elective basis.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover from taxable goods or services
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egyptian e-invoicing is mandatory for VAT registrants above the ETA-designated revenue thresholds. Invoices must be generated through approved B2B/B2C systems and transmitted in XML or JSON to the ETA platform in real time. The system performs automated schema validation, fiscal stamp application, and issuance of a unified invoice number with a QR-code-based digital stamp. Unscrupulous manual invoices or rejected submissions are legally treated as non-issued invoices and trigger penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods qualify for 0% VAT where the goods are physically exported pursuant to a valid customs export declaration and the foreign-exchange proceeds are received within the statutory period. Offshore services, including AI/LLM API services supplied to a non-resident business customer, qualify for zero-rating where the recipient is outside Egypt, the service is consumed outside the Egyptian customs and tax territory, payment is received from foreign currency, and the Egyptian provider is not making a separate domestic VAT supply. The zero-rating claim must be supported by written contracts, service delivery documentation, and the customer's non-resident status evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (C52 or equivalent electronic export declaration)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / directly applicable transport document
Commercial Invoice and custom value declaration
Inward Remittance Certificate or Central Bank of Egypt foreign exchange receipt evidencing repatriation of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA audits zero-rating and refund claims under a risk-based e-filter. A taxpayer failing to substantiate delivery, export, or repatriation within 180 days will have the zero-rating reversed at 14% VAT, with input VAT recovered by way of recapture. Additional penalties include monthly late-payment interest, administrative fines of up to 200% of the tax evaded, and, in cases of intentional fraudulent documentation or forged customs declarations, criminal sanctions including imprisonment, licence deregistration, and retrospective clawback up to five years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Egyptian Pound (EGP) is largely convertible for current-account transactions under the Foreign Exchange Law No. 194 of 2020, while capital-account movements remain subject to CBE prior-approval or referral rules. Profit remittances are permitted after satisfying Egyptian tax clearance, settlement of trade finance obligations, and submission of audited financial statements. Following the March 2024 exchange-rate float and IMF-backed reform, no mandatory surrender ratio applies to export receipts, and FX availability is governed by the interbank market supply and demand framework.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBE Circular No. 65 of 2022 (as amended), export proceeds must be repatriated to Egypt within 90 days from the date of shipment unless the exporter's bank grants an approved extension. The previously applicable mandatory conversion percentages (e.g., 50% for exporters) were abolished with the March 2024 exchange-rate regime; export proceeds may be credited to foreign-currency accounts, and conversion to EGP is conducted at the prevailing interbank market rate when settlement obligations require EGP.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low — Offshore fintech EMIs (e.g., Payoneer, Revolut Business) are not licensed as authorized dealers under Egyptian banking law and cannot operate as CBE-compliant settlement institutions for the mandated treasury flows. They may be used only as merchant collection gateways on the customer-facing side, but all final FX settlement, capital injection, and export proceeds repatriation must route through a licensed Egyptian bank under the CBE open-market exchange regime.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for corporate account onboarding: at least one authorized director and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) must appear in person at the bank's designated branch for a face-to-face KYC interview and biometric verification. Remote video KYC cannot substitute for the initial onboarding interview for non-resident-owned entities unless a specific low-risk exemption is granted in writing by the bank's compliance committee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO domiciled in a sanctioned or high-risk jurisdiction with elevated PEP exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid certified passport copy of UBO; proof of residential address; notarized UBO declaration; source-of-wealth statement; professional reference from a regulated foreign bank; completed PEP risk-rating questionnaire; detailed corporate structure depiction from UBO through each intermediary

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: AI-API platform with no physical office and volatile multi-jurisdictional online receivables
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation and entity register excerpt; audited or reviewed financial statements; executed enterprise agreements showing real commercial substance; operating platform description and product documentation; customer invoices and payment processing statements (Stripe, PayPal); ISIC 6201 activity confirmation and exemption letter from the General Authority for Investment showing no statutory license barrier

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Receipt of cryptocurrency (USDC) payments and related digital-asset conversion activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Institutional wallet ownership attestation with custodian audited records; licensed-exchange transaction statements; Know-Your-Transaction (KYT) compliance reports tracing USDC-to-fiat conversion; evidence of no CBE prohibition against receiving crypto-backed payment in a generated statutory legal opinion; documented internal AML policy covering crypto-to-fiat conversion events

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire transfer protocol for inbound equity injection from foreign parent: SWIFT MT103 with the CBE-recognized purpose code identifying Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) — equity capital, including the unique investment number issued by the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) for verification. The receiving Egyptian bank credits the Capital Escrow Account after running name screening, FX contract execution, and obtaining any CBE no-objection certificate for capital account transaction. Prior to credit, the bank may request a reconciliation package including the copy of the GAFI incorporation certificate, board resolution approving the injection, and the investor's banking declaration form.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for operating expenses, software licensing, and service fees will be cleared via SWIFT MT103 messages over the correspondent banking network, with FX conversion at the interbank mid-rate plus controlled margin. High-value physical equipment imports or platform infrastructure procurement may require the issuance of an irrevocable commercial letter of credit (LC) under UCP 600 through the Egyptian issuing bank, normally on a fixed-for-surety basis. Profit remittances to the foreign parent require annual audited financial statements, tax clearance certificate from the Egyptian Tax Authority, and submission of CBE form of current-account transfer via the handling bank.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Egyptian-pound/USD deliverable outright forwards in the onshore interbank market with standard corporate collateral requirements
EGP/USD cross-currency swaps between the corporate treasury and the Egyptian bank under repeat ISDA or local master agreement terms

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for EGP limited to non-resident financial counterparties; onshore usage is not permitted without specific CBE authorization, and any NDF settlement must be booked through a compliant financial advisor

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form No. 11)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of fiscal year-end (by 30 April for a 31 December year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly delay penalty of 2% of outstanding tax (up to 100%) plus annual interest at the statutory lending rate; persistent non-filing may trigger enforced collection and criminal prosecution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements filing with the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry under the General Authority for Investment & Free Zones (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days of shareholders' approval and no later than the end of the sixth month after fiscal year-end (typically 30 June for a 31 December year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of EGP 5,000–10,000 (approx. USD 160–320) per delay; repeated failure may result in administrative strike-off of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Shareholders' General Assembly Resolution and Minutes Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry (as approving the audited financial statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be held and filed within the six-month period following the fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold or file the AGM resolution attracts fines under the Companies Law; persistent neglect may lead to judicial dissolution or administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for all limited liability companies regardless of size or turnover; the law requires appointment of an accredited auditor at formation and annual audit of financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) – substantially aligned with IFRS

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the AML Law (Trust and Corporate Service Providers Regulations), each company must maintain a Beneficial Ownership register and submit an annual confirmation to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) declaring any changes to ownership structure. Share transfers require an updated UBO filing within 30 days.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard onshore LLC: none; 22.5% applies to adjusted net profit. Investment Law No. 72/2017: qualifying projects in Zone A may receive a 50% CIT discount for up to 5 years; SCZONE free-zone entities may obtain 0% CIT for up to 15 years. Export income incentives: 50% of profits derived from exported services (including software/AI-API services) may be deducted if foreign currency is transferred through an Egyptian bank and ETA conditions are met. R&D/technical research expenses may attract additional deductions per ministerial determinations; no automatic holiday for an onshore AI/LLM API LLC unless formal incentive registration is obtained.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 19 (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return for legal persons); filed electronically via the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) Unified E-Filing Portal (Misaha/e-Tax platform) with the e-invoicing environment linked to the taxpayer TIN.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; three quarterly advance CIT installments are payable during the tax year (the 4th, 6th, and 9th months) based on the prior year's tax liability, followed by the final annual self-assessment.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months after the close of the fiscal year. For a 31-December fiscal year-end: filed and final balance paid by 30 April of the following year; taxpayers with an approved different fiscal year file within 4 months of their own year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the LLC, unified tax card number (TIN), commercial registry number, legal form, registered address, and contact details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify the Egyptian TIN is active; disclose ultimate non-resident shareholders and their country of tax residence; no foreign tax ID filing is required on this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section A – Box 2: Fiscal Year / Accounting Period
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Start and end dates of the tax period (e.g., 01/01/2025–31/12/2025); the period must match the audited financial statements used.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Egyptian LLC cannot adopt the foreign parent's fiscal year unless prior ETA authorization exists; non-resident group consolidation is not reflected in this return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section B – Box 3: Financial Statements Summary
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue, cost of sales, operating expenses, financing income/expense, profit before tax, and net profit extracted from the IFRS/EGAAP audited accounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all amounts in EGP; foreign-currency API token, subscription and USDC receipts must be translated at the Central Bank of Egypt exchange rate on transaction date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section B – Box 4: Non-Deductible Expenses and Add-Backs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Provisions, unrealized losses, entertainment above statutory limits, excessive interest, non-commercial donations, and related-party service fees lacking arm's length support.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fees paid to non-resident affiliates require proof of actual service, a 20% WHT certificate, and a transfer pricing analysis; otherwise add-back is mandatory.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section C – Box 5: Taxable Income Computation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjusted taxable profit after add-backs, tax depreciation recalculated per Law 91/2005, and carryforward losses deductible up to a 5-year limit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Egyptian losses cannot be used by non-resident shareholders; branch or partnership loss flows are not permitted under the entity-level taxation model.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section C – Box 6: Tax Rate Application and Incentives
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply 22.5% statutory rate; enter applicable investment-law 50% CIT discount, digital/software export profit deduction (50% of eligible export profit), and any free-zone exemption.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only activity physically performed and controlled by the Egyptian LLC qualifies for incentives; offshore arrangements do not qualify and carry documentation obligations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section D – Box 7: Advance Payments and Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate quarterly CIT installments paid, WHT credits, and any foreign tax credit claimed under a DTA with supporting calculation annexes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign tax credit requires a valid Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) and an audited calculation; judicial interest from Egyptian courts falls under different rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section E – Box 8: Tax Due or Refund Calculation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final CIT payable after all credits; if delay occurs, the ETA self-assessment mechanism automatically computes monthly late-payment interest.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Final balance must be paid from the Egyptian LLC's own bank account in Egypt; payments from offshore group accounts are not accepted as discharge.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section F – Box 9: Transfer Pricing Declaration and Controlled Transactions Schedule
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List all related-party transactions, specify the arm's length method applied (CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split), and certify Local File/Master File availability where thresholds are exceeded.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include AI-IP licensing fees, data hosting charges, intercompany software tools, management fees, and USDC-denominated settlements with the non-resident parent; attach an APP transaction schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section G – Box 10: Signatures and Certifications
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature and date by the legal representative and authorized tax accountant; attach the audited statements and the attested power of attorney where applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident investor may authorize a resident tax agent via a notarized and attested POA; both the representative and the agent bear joint responsibility for accuracy.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: monthly surcharge of 5% of the assessed CIT for each commenced month of delay in addition to the full tax; refusal to file or submission of false declarations triggers a fixed fine (EGP 500–EGP 20,000) plus the monthly surcharge. Late payment: prejudgment-type interest accrues at the Central Bank of Egypt discount rate plus 2% annually. More serious false-declaration cases attract a 40% additional tax on the under-assessed difference; enforcement includes bank account attachment, tax lien registration, administrative closure of the tax file, and travel bans.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final WHT on dividend distributions to non-resident shareholders; the paying Egyptian LLC is the withholding agent. The domestic 10% rate applies to distributions from profits; treaty rates commonly range from 5% to 15% depending on shareholding structure.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: (1) The non-resident shareholder/beneficial owner obtains an annual TRC from its revenue authority, apostilled or legalized as Egyptian practice requires and translated to Arabic if demanded. (2) The LLC files an 'Application for Reduced DTA Withholding Rate' at the ETA central directorate for large/mid taxpayers attaching the TRC, constitutional documents, shareholding registry extract, and a DTA article analysis confirming beneficial ownership. (3) Upon ETA written pre-approval, the reduced rate is applied at source; if no pre-approval is obtained, 10%/20% statutory WHT is withheld and the foreign claimant files a refund with the ETA within the 5-year statute of limitations, submitting withholding certificates and bank transfer evidence. (4) The reduced rate is reflected in the LLC's annual CIT return only after the ETA ruling is issued.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT: 20% for royalties and 20% for arm's length interest paid to non-residents; royalties for patents, know-how and software/AI-IP licensing are caught in full. Statutory exemptions apply to qualifying external project finance interest per ETA conditions. Under many Egyptian DTAs, royalty and interest WHT is reduced to 10%–15%; interest paid to official government/central bank lenders is frequently 0%. All treaty reductions require the same TRC and beneficial-ownership documentation protocol.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File: mandatory where controlled transactions with a single related party exceed EGP 10 million in a tax year. Master File: mandatory where the multinational group's consolidated revenue exceeds EGP 500 million. CbCR notification applies where group consolidated revenue crosses the statutory threshold (approximately EUR 750 million equivalent, per Ministerial Decree No. 716/2018). Non-compliance with TP documentation obligations attracts penalties up to EGP 100,000 per required file and allocation of profits by deemed assessment.
